definitions.explanation: A pure substance consisting of atoms that all have the same number of protons; one of the fundamental building blocks of matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水素|すいそ}→水素：00387_suiso⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{元素|げんそ}だ。
{元素|げんそ}⟦{記号|きごう}→記号：00224_kigou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
⟦{周期表|しゅうきひょう}→周期表：21305_shuukihyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧118⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{元素|げんそ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
{元素|げんそ} refers specifically to chemical elements — the fundamental substances that cannot be broken down further by chemical means.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {元素|げんそ}⟦{記号|きごう}→記号：00224_kigou⟧: element symbol (e.g., H, O, Fe)
- {元素|げんそ}⟦{周期表|しゅうきひょう}→周期表：21305_shuukihyou⟧: periodic table of elements
- ⟦{放射性|ほうしゃせい}→放射性：28219_houshasei⟧{元素|げんそ}: radioactive element
- {希土類|きどるい}{元素|げんそ}: rare earth element
- ⟦{微量|びりょう}→微量：12604_biryou⟧{元素|げんそ}: trace element

CONTRAST WITH {要素|ようそ}:
{元素|げんそ} is strictly a chemistry term. ⟦{要素|ようそ}→要素：03661_youso⟧ means 'element' in the general sense of a component or factor (e.g., ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要素|ようそ}→要素：03661_youso⟧ = elements of success).
